strings.subtitle: — Faka'auha faile —
strings.dnd_hint: (pe toho ha faile ki he matapa ni)
strings.dnd_unavailable: ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻa e toho mo e tuku. Ngāueʻaki ʻa e foʻi ki ʻi lalo.
strings.strategy_full: ☢  KAKATO — meʻa kotoa ʻi he noa (malu)
strings.shred_button: F A K A ʻ A U H A
strings.ssd_warning:
Tokanga! ʻI he SSD, ʻoku ʻikai fakapapauʻi ʻe he founga tohi ʻi ʻolunga ʻa e fakaʻauhá koeʻuhí ko e TRIM.
Ko e polokalama ni ʻoku maʻa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ko e faile "{name}" ʻe tohi ʻi ʻolunga pea tamateʻi.

Fakatau?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Ko ha shortcut eni (.lnk). Ko e shortcut pe 'e 'auha.

Ko e hinga 'oku ne fakahinohino ki ai 'e nofo pē.

Hoko atu?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Ko ha network drive eni (\\server\share).
'Oku 'ikai ke fakapapau'i 'e he tohi 'i he sekito 'a e 'auha — mahalo 'oku ma'u 'e he seva ha snapshot, deduplication pe CoW.

Hoko atu?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Ko ha removable drive eni (USB / HDD tu'a).
Mahalo 'e tauhi 'e he pule 'a e poloka motu'a 'i he tauhi'anga.

Hoko atu?
strings.error_cannot_read:
ʻOku ʻikai lava ʻo lau e faile:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  NAʻE TOHI E FAILE ʻI ʻOLUNGA PEĀ TAMATEʻI
strings.report_limits:
• ʻOku ʻikai ngāueʻi ʻa e NTFS hala ʻo e ʻīkuna kehe (ADS).
• ʻOku ʻikai fakamaʻa ʻa e tohinoa USN.
• ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻa e tauhi ʻata mo e fengāueʻaki ʻi he ʻao
  (OneDrive mo e hā fua).
strings.step_delete: Tamateʻi ʻo fakalaka ʻi he puha ʻuhu
strings.status_full: Kuo tohi kakato ʻa e ʻīkuna ʻi he noa. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke toe maʻu — ʻe sio pē ʻa e ngaahi meʻangāue ki he noa.
strings.status_fast: Kuo tohi ʻa e ʻulu, ikuʻanga mo e 4 MB laine ʻi ʻolunga. ʻOku ʻikai maʻu ʻa e toe, ka koeʻuhí ko e ʻatā ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe he ngaahi meʻangāue kaihoa ʻo toe maʻu kakato. Maʻa e ngaahi tohi fakapulipuli, ngāueʻaki ʻa e sīpili KAKATO.
strings.status_empty: Naʻe moʻua e faile, naʻe ʻikai fiemaʻu ʻa e tohi ʻi ʻolunga. Kuo tamateʻi.
strings.error_permission: 'Ikai ke lava 'o a'u ki he hinga. Mahalo 'oku ava 'i ha polokalame kehe. Tāmate'i ia pea toe feinga.
strings.error_not_found: 'Ikai ke ma'u 'a e hinga. Mahalo kuo 'osi tāmate'i.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ko ha symbolic link eni. 'Oku 'ikai ke lava 'o 'auha 'a e link — 'e nofo pē 'a e hinga 'oku ne fakahinohino ki ai.
strings.error_reparse: Ko ha placeholder hinga eni (OneDrive pe hā). 'Oku tauhi hono fakamatala 'i he 'ao, 'ikai 'i he tisi — 'oku 'ikai ha me'a ke 'auha heni.
strings.error_not_file: 'Oku 'ikai ko ha hinga eni (ko ha fōtā pe ha me'a kehe). Tuku ha hinga.
strings.error_hardlinks: 'Oku ma'u 'e he hinga ni ha hard link kehe ({n} kotoa). 'Oku 'ikai ke ma'u 'e he hard link ha tokotaha 'uluaki — 'oku tatau 'a e hingoa kotoa. Kapau te ke 'auha 'i he founga lolotonga, 'e tohi'i 'a e fakamatala 'o tu'usi ki he 32 bytes, ka 'e nofo pē 'a e toe 'o lava ke a'u ki ai 'i he ngaahi link kehe. Tāmate'i 'a e link kotoa 'uluaki.
strings.error_compressed:
'Oku compressed, encrypted pe sparse 'a e hinga. 'Oku 'ikai ke fakapapau'i 'e he tohi 'aki 'a e noa 'a e 'auha 'o e fakamatala motu'a koe'uhi 'oku tauhi 'e NTFS 'a e me'a ni 'i ha founga kehe.

To'o 'a e 'atipauto: lomi'i he to'omata'u → Ngaahi me'a → Fakalakalaka → to'o 'a e 'Compress' mo/pe 'Encrypt'. Hili ia, faka'ū SHREDDER 'i he toe taimi.
strings.queue_hint: (pe tolo'i 'a e hinga ki he matapā ni)
strings.queue_confirm_text:
'E 'auha 'a e hinga 'e {count}.
Lahi kotoa: {size}.

Sio ki he lisi kimu'a pea hoko atu.
'Oku 'ikai ke lava 'a e ngaue ni 'o fakafoki.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
To'o 'a e hinga kotoa {count} mei he laini?

Ko e hinga tonu 'E 'IKAI ke uesia — ko e lisi pe.
strings.hardlink_text:
'Oku ma'u 'e he hinga "{name}" ha hard link kehe ({nlink} kotoa).

'E 'auha 'a e fakamatala ki he hingoa kotoa.
Ka 'e nofo 'a e toe 'i he lalo hingoa kehe 'i he fōtā.

Mahalo 'e fiema'u ke ke tāmate'i 'a e toe ni 'aki ho nima.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Ngāue'aki ki he hard link kotoa 'i he laini
